images.scene: Robinson and Friday heave the huge finished canoe inch by inch across the sand toward the water, the heavy hull riding on a line of round log rollers laid on the ground, both men leaning hard against the stern with ropes taut.
images.alt: 两人用滚木一寸寸把大独木舟推向海里。

images.scene: The boat glides across the sea under a small three-cornered patched sail bellied by the wind, Robinson at the stern working a wooden rudder while Friday stands frozen in the bow, mouth open and arms stiff, staring astonished at the swinging sail.
images.alt: 小舟扬起三角帆行驶,星期五呆立船头惊讶地望着摆动的帆。

images.scene: The large canoe rests in a shallow dug dock at the edge of the creek behind a mud dam, roofed over with a thick layer of leafy tree boughs piled so densely it looks like the thatch of a house, hiding the vessel from view.
images.alt: 大独木舟停在挖好的小船坞里,上面盖满厚厚的树枝像屋顶一样把它藏住。

images.scene: On a wooden bench inside the fortification, Robinson pours powder and rams shot into a row of muskets, fowling-pieces and two pistols laid out side by side, a great naked sword hung at his side and a hatchet set out ready for Friday.
images.alt: 罗滨逊在寨子里逐一给一排火枪和手枪装填火药弹丸,佩剑在腰,一把手斧备给星期五。

images.scene: On the open beach Robinson kneels over a bearded European man lying bound with rushes on the sand, slicing the twisted bindings from his wrists with a knife, while nearby Friday stands firing a musket toward canoes at the water's edge.
images.alt: 罗滨逊在沙滩上跪着用刀割断被捆西班牙人手上的草绳,星期五在旁向水边的独木舟开枪。

images.scene: Locked in a wrestling struggle on the sand, a stout savage pins the weakened bearded Spaniard beneath him and wrenches at a sword, while the Spaniard, flat on his back, draws a pistol from his belt and fires it point-blank into the attacker's body in a puff of smoke.
images.alt: 沙地上壮实的野人把虚弱的西班牙人压在身下夺剑,西班牙人仰面抽出手枪贴身开火。
